CustomField.description: Second condition, § 37 Abs. 5 Nr. 2: die erneute Eichung unverzueglich beantragt wird. This is the trap in the exemption - the repair keeps the Eichfrist alive only if a re-calibration is applied for immediately. The industry asked the ministry in April 2026 to delete this Nummer precisely because of what it costs, which tells you it bites.
CustomField.label: Nacheichung unverzüglich beantragt
